assignments.description: Document Uploaded once every certificate required for the Account Type is collected; otherwise Document Pending.
assignments.name: Set_Document_Status
assignments.label: Set Document Status

Flow.description: Keeps Contact.Agreement_Status__c at Document Pending / Document Uploaded for Vendor Contacts, based on the certificates required for the Account Type (Food and Beverage: Food Service + W-9; Non-Profit: COI, W-9 optional; Sales Activation: COI, W-9 optional). Only acts while the status is blank, Document Pending or Document Uploaded - Ready to Send (Vendor Activation flow) and the Adobe Sign statuses (Adobe Agreement - Update Contact Status flow) are never changed here.

formulas.description: True when every certificate required for the Account Type has been collected.
formulas.name: frmAllDocumentsCollected
formulas.expression: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Food and Beverage"), {!$Record.Food_Services_Certificate_Collected__c}, {!$Record.W_9_Collected__c}), AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Non-Profit"), {!$Record.COI_Collected__c}), AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Sales Activation"), {!$Record.COI_Collected__c}) )

Flow.label: Contact - Set Certificate Document Status

start.filterFormula: AND( {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = "Vendor_Contact", OR(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Food and Beverage"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Non-Profit"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Account.Type}, "Sales Activation")), OR(ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record.Agreement_Status__c})), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Agreement_Status__c}, "Document Pending"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Agreement_Status__c}, "Document Uploaded")))
